nl: 用 antd 风格做询价单管理：查询有产品名称；表格展示产品名称、产品类别、数量、备注；支持新增、编辑、删除。表单里「备注」在产品类别不是「其它」且不是「自定义」，同时数量大于 0 时隐藏（标准品按统一规格，无需备注）。
nlEn: Quotation management with an Ant Design look: query by product name; the table shows product name, category, quantity and remark; supports add, edit and delete. In the form, the "remark" is hidden when the category is neither "other" nor "custom" AND the quantity is greater than 0 (standard products follow a fixed spec and need no remark).
notes: AI-16: 表达式 isHidden（and + nin + 序关系 >）—— 标准品且数量>0 时隐藏备注（antdv/schema）
